verdict.rationale: WorkOS ships Radar, a first-party "Bot & Fraud Protection" product described as protecting apps "from bots, fraud, and abuse." It is a built-in, metered part of the platform (first 1,000 checks free, then per-50K-check pricing), so bot protection on auth flows is directly covered. Credential stuffing and brute-force defenses are only implied by the generic "fraud and abuse" wording. missing for 10: explicit documentation of credential-stuffing and brute-force protections (e.g., rate limiting, lockout, breached-password detection), in-depth Radar docs on how it hooks into AuthKit flows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
